_comment: Measured outcomes against the design in CLAUDE.md. Nothing here redefines the design; it only records what was observed. Off-ledger exploration goes in FINDINGS.md, never here. RESET 2026-09-10 for the return to Town01 (A19, A20): every number is measured on the rebuilt harness with training that reproduces byte for byte, and nothing is carried over from the large-map rebuild, whose results are withdrawn.

M0.note: CLAUDE.md, the design section, locked and tagged protocol-v1

M1.note: Town01, chosen by measured geometry. Study site road 15, 1007 ft flat, pavement both sides, street lighting 3.25 with the lamps off. The false-activation scenario needs 320 m and this map's longest straight is 307 m, so ledger cells 5 and 6 are deferred (A20).

M2.note: Measured again 2026-09-10 on the rebuilt harness. Peak braking 0.5048 g read from stop time, 0.4863 g read from distance covered, which is the 3.7% consistency question that stays open. Latency 0.150 s. Required range 52.0 ft at 25 mph. Contact detector validated on a deliberate crash. Both oracles 10/10 correct and 0/10 late, every repetition identical to the recorded precision.

M3.note: Expert passes 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints. Camera frames recaptured under the current rules, darkest first, cloud cover zero, and every frame set now carries a harness stamp recording map, cloud cover, settle, rules digest, texture streaming, quality level and capture order.

M4.note: All three policies pass all three lighting conditions the standard tests, on both hazard scenarios, 10/10 in every one of eighteen cells. By the standard's own procedure the policies cannot be told apart. Training reproduces byte for byte and all three arms train on 2912 samples from the measured axis (F30, F34).

M5.note: All twelve behavioural checks pass over the covered range. Worst covered values: capture 0.8206, in-between 0.8578, both against a threshold of 1.0. Three in-between checks exceed the threshold only inside the uncovered sliver at the horizon, which is excluded from every verdict by construction.

M6.note: Six certificates over the covered range, committed to git before any driving. Continuum-trained 12/12 on both scenarios. Points-trained 6/12 on lead, falsified over 17.24 deg, and 3/12 on pedestrian, falsified over 55.84 deg. Three-condition 6/12 and 8/12. Zero undecided in all six. The two point-trained arms falsify the SAME six pieces on lead, a contiguous band from +17.484 to +0.241 deg.

M7.note: Complete. 78 witness drives and 390 interior drives, three repetitions each with its own restarted server. ZERO certified-then-failed and zero void. Driven at 65 light levels: continuum 0 crashes on both scenarios, three-condition 15 and 25, points 21 and 9. On lead the driven failures span +8.856 to +0.608 deg inside a certificate warning from +17.484 to 0.000, so the bound brackets the truth and is conservative both sides. On pedestrian the failures are TWO DISJOINT POCKETS.

M8.note: Report and figures regenerated from these results. Remaining: the Novi demo, and the paper repository, whose every measured number predates this rebuild.
